questions.q: In a 0520 paper, what does the instruction « Cochez la bonne case » mean?
questions.why: Cocher = to tick; la case = the box.

questions.q: You hear: « D'habitude, je vais à la piscine le samedi, mais ce samedi, je vais au cinéma. » Où va-t-il ce samedi ?
questions.why: « D'habitude… à la piscine » is the distractor; « mais ce samedi » gives the answer.

questions.q: Under which topic area does a part-time job belong?
questions.why: Part-time work, careers and further education are all in area D.

questions.q: Name the four components of Cambridge IGCSE French 0520 and the weighting of each.
questions.model: Listening, Reading, Speaking and Writing — each worth 25%.
